messages:
Anna M: FYI I think I found a subtle cross-workspace glitch in Console sidepanel.
Anna M: Steps: 1) on org A open org switcher -> click workspace X, 2) open left sidepanel Saved Filters immediately, 3) UI flashes list for workspace Y (previous), then resolves to X after ~400–700ms.
Mike H: can repro on canary, good catch.
Ben L: is this the prefetch shortcut we added last month?
Anna M: looks like prefetch is keyed only by route + user, not workspaceId. The prefetch request payload has workspace null for some flows.
Jess K: any logs? request headers maybe missing x-workspace-id or cookie race
Anna M: I grabbed a HAR — header absent on the first prefetch call. Also saw telemetry event `sidepanel.prefetch` without `workspace_id` property.
Ben L: that explains transient flash. frontend shows stale cache then updates on full fetch.
Mike H: quick patch idea: include workspaceId in prefetch key and in cache-buster header. Also add guard in prefetch to await active workspace selection.
Jess K: paste the small diff I made in console/prefetch.ts
Jess K: ```ts
- const key = `${route}:${userId}`
+ const key = `${route}:${userId}:${workspaceId}`
+ if (!workspaceId) await waitForWorkspaceSelection()
``` 
Anna M: that looks sensible.
Ben L: related infra note — our edge-router strips `x-workspace-id` for anonymous prefetch requests when token absent. Might need to preserve it for internal prefetches.
Mike H: filed infra ticket: infra-879 to stop dropping header for internal client calls.
infra-bot: Deploy queued: canary-console-2026-03-20T14:03 - includes PR #4321 by @Jess K
Anna M: Can we add a tiny e2e that fast-switches orgs and asserts no cross-workspace results flash? Even a 1s sleep case.
Jess K: adding test + telemetry assert for `sidepanel.prefetch` workspace_id present. Will link PR.
Ben L: schedule canary rollout (5% -> 50% -> 100%) after infra fix.
Mike H: assigning to Jess for PR, Anna for QA verification.
Anna M: thanks team. saved the HAR + screenshots to the thread folder: https://files.redwood.cons/har/1749999998.json
Anna M: +cc @security only for awareness (no PII)
Mike H: 👍
